steps.title: CEO review
steps.prompt_template: Act as the product-minded founder for ${request}. Reframe the user need, challenge weak assumptions, and define the narrowest wedge worth shipping now.

steps.title: Engineering plan
steps.prompt_template: Act as the engineering lead for ${proposal.title}. Turn the CEO direction into an execution plan with architecture, failure modes, and a concrete implementation order.

steps.title: Implementation worker
steps.request_template: Implement the approved feature plan for ${proposal.title}. Use the CEO and engineering outputs as context. Make concrete code or doc changes, not just advice.

steps.title: Review worker
steps.request_template: Review the implementation for ${proposal.title}. Focus on correctness, regressions, missing tests, and production risk. Return concrete findings or an explicit clean result.

steps.title: QA worker
steps.request_template: Test the result for ${proposal.title}. Verify the intended behavior, identify gaps, and describe the exact evidence for pass or fail.

steps.title: Shipping decision
steps.prompt_template: Act as the one-person-company operator for ${proposal.title}. Synthesize the outputs so far, decide whether to ship, and produce a final execution brief. If another iteration is needed, return a controller decision with the next iteration.

steps.title: Implement requested change
steps.prompt_template: Act as the implementation worker for ${request}. Make the requested code or documentation changes directly, then summarize what changed and any remaining risk.

steps.title: Review implementation
steps.prompt_template: Act as the review worker for ${request}. Focus on correctness, regressions, missing tests, and production risk. Return findings first, then residual risk if no findings exist.

steps.title: Verify behavior
steps.prompt_template: Act as the QA worker for ${request}. Verify intended behavior, check for regressions, run the most relevant validation you can, and explain the evidence for pass or fail.
